name: Coming to Terms
label: Quest
description: Offered by Aramis Hammerhand in Deathknell, this quest tasks newly risen paladins with reaching out to a fellow knight struggling to accept undeath.…
intro: Offered by Aramis Hammerhand in Deathknell, this quest tasks newly risen paladins with reaching out to a fellow knight struggling to accept undeath. Fleeing into the hills in terror, the newly returned warrior faces the agonizing realization of becoming what she once fought against.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Not all of our fellow Paladins who rise again are quick to acclimate to our new reality. Some struggle to reconcile that they are now, in a way, the very thing they spent their lives fighting against.

These individuals often simply need a kind gesture and a sympathetic ear. Unfortunately, many others are quick to turn violent. Find the frightened paladin who fled into the hills directly west of this chapel. Extend a hand in friendship. Lead them back into the light if you can.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Coming to terms with this new life is not easy for any of us. For some it's simply more than they can bear.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Tragically, more than a few of our brothers and sisters succumb to a similar madness after being risen. As precious as every Forsaken soul is, sometimes the best we can do is grant those that cannot acclimate a clean end.
I will say a prayer to the light for her. Thank you for doing what must be done, friend.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
